name: The majority voted in favour of keeping [schedule 1](https://www.aph.gov.au/Parliamentary_Business/Bills_Legislation/bd/bd2223a/23bd076#scroll-nav__10), [schedule 2](https://www.aph.gov.au/Parliamentary_Business/Bills_Legislation/bd/bd2223a/23bd076#scroll-nav__11) and [schedule 8](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;db=LEGISLATION;id=legislation%2Fbills%2Fr7011_first-reps%2F0008;query=Id%3A%22legislation%2Fbills%2Fr7011_first-reps%2F0000%22;rec=0) unchanged. This vote was in response to a motion to oppose those schedules and means that they will remain as they are.
